4475.title: Account Pooler extra-usage eligibility
4475.rootCauseOneLine: Subscription exhaustion filters the account before synthetic extra-usage fallback can reach the model transport.
4475.proposedFix: Track validated extra availability separately and implement subscription-first fallback with disabled/spent controls.
caveats: Synthetic provider data and injected transport; no real billing or paid request.
Multi-account preference, affinity, restart and provider payload verification remain untested.
PR4531 open and unmerged; only current main tested.
